title: LA passage: consonantia
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a la passage.

consonantia

Language: la

anchor.prefix: correspond to the necessary phases of artistic apprehension. Find these and you find the qualities of universal beauty. Aquinas says: Ad pulcritudinem tria requiruntur integritas,
anchor.suffix:
, claritas. I translate it so: Three things are needed for beauty, wholeness, harmony and radiance. Do these correspond to the phases of apprehension? Are you following?

 —Of cour
